title: Nothing Happens
description: The uprising pauses. Footsteps fade. For a moment, you are alone between factions.

effects.message: The halls stay quiet — for now.

title: Undead Patrol
description: Resurrected inmates sweep the corridor. You duck aside — a card slips from your grip.

effects.message: An undead patrol forces you to duck aside — you lose a card from your hand.

title: Find Herbs
description: Bitter prison moss grows between stones near the old gallows. It steadies the nerves.

effects.message: You gather herbs and recover a discarded card.

title: Anarchist Stash
description: A loose brick hides a forgotten revolutionary cache. Someone meant to come back for this.

effects.message: You pocket a small cache and recover two discarded cards.

title: Gallows Ambush
description: A hanging corpse drops from the rafters. You fight free, but your grip falters.

effects.message: A hanging corpse ambushes you — two cards are lost from hand.

title: Whispered Rumor
description: A half-mad inmate whispers of faction lines — Anarchists, Guards, and a sorcerer's trail.

effects.message: The rumor points you toward nearby chambers.

title: Collapsed Corridor
description: Stone groans as the uprising shakes the foundations. Dust and panic scramble your cards.

title: Guard Whistle
description: A surviving watchman signals. Order still holds a pocket of the fortress — for now.

effects.message: You note which halls the living Guards still claim.

title: Corridor Riot
description: Bodies surge past. Your carefully ordered cards are torn into chaos.

effects.message: The riot scatters every pile you carried.

title: Press Gang
description: Faction recruiters shove a spare blade into your pack — whether you wanted it or not.

effects.message: A spare Heavy Strike is forced into your deck.

title: Warden's Tax
description: A tax collector of the old order pries at your guard. Your shield wavers.

effects.message: The tax leaves your shield thinner.

title: Stolen Buckler
description: You pry a cracked buckler from a fallen guard. It will not last, but it holds for now.

title: Armorer's Scrap
description: A half-mad smith hammers a patch onto your guard — crude, but it holds for now.

title: Poisoned Rivet
description: Corrosion eats at your armor. Your guard weakens.

effects.message: Your shield buckles under the rot.

title: Arcane Residue
description: A cracked ward-stone still hums. The leftover charge settles behind your eyes.

effects.message: Residue flows into you — mana rises.

title: Null Ward
description: A dead mage's seal flares once and drinks the air. Your focus thins.

title: Smuggled Raise Shield
description: An Anarchist slips you a battered Raise Shield card. It joins your pack.

effects.message: Raise Shield is added to your hand.
